summary.text: Qi Wall is Primordial Origin Immortal Venerable's qi path immortal killer move left in Heavenly Court. It is not the heavenly wind qi wall that borders the immemorial heavens.

claims.text: When Longevity Heaven’s force enters Heavenly Court, the immortals name the surrounding formless fortress as the immortal killer move Qi Wall left by Primordial Origin Immortal Venerable. They call the base method ordinary, yet say Primordial Origin was skilled with it young, enjoyed using it, and raised it to rank nine when he became invincible. In that rank nine form they judge it even stronger than the heavenly wind qi wall. Air ripples into a formless wall that bursts under heavy attack, then gathers again; Heavenly Court members pass without obstruction while the wall presses invaders.
Duke Long and Fairy Zi Wei treat the old move as long exposed: three Demon Venerables once carved paths through it by force, and those roads remain its weak lines that cannot regenerate the same way.

Primordial Origin’s qi wall killer move left in Heavenly Court can discern enemy and ally: it does not obstruct Heavenly Court members, but it is a huge problem for Longevity Heaven’s side. Northern Plains Gu Immortals are forced to fight along the Demon Venerable road while the wall protects other Heavenly Court sites.

Facing a grand blade qi, Duke Long shouts and uses Qi Wall. Qi wall is the most common defensive killer move of qi path, yet his cast is not simple: he uses it three times in a consecutive move so one layer expands twice into a thicker fusion of three walls. The blade qi collapses that wall while dispersing most of its own force, and the remnant cannot threaten him.

After the Eastern Sea struggle over Dragon Palace, Fang Yuan (as Qi Sea Ancestor) presses Duke Long into handing over the first half of Primordial Origin’s qi path true inheritance; that half mainly talks about the killer move Qi Wall. Narration states that Qi Wall is Primordial Origin’s signature method, renowned in history, and Duke Long yields it only under Fang Yuan’s firm demand while seeking a truce. Fang Yuan studies the move to understand Heavenly Court’s qi wall arrangement and try to break it, noting the venerable-era method may be outdated enough to unravel, though success is uncertain.

Primordial Origin left the killer move Qi Wall throughout Heavenly Court; when three Demon Venerables attacked they created three paths without qi wall, and other areas stay filled by it. Once activated, the wall seals Calamity Luck Altar, exerts huge pressure from all directions, and mends behind the house as it crawls, so the killer move’s self-recovery keeps the altar trapped.

Known users.text: Primordial Origin Immortal Venerable (creator) Duke Long
